summary: Flutter screen sharing now has an explicit opt-in to publish eligible system/game/app playback as a separate LiveKit screenShareAudio track. Capture paths are wired for Windows, Linux, macOS 13+, Android 10+, and iOS ReplayKit Broadcast Extension. Build and source tests pass; runtime audio acceptance remains unproven.

checks.name: Focused Flutter regression tests
checks.observation: All 61 tests passed, including native capture option propagation, audio-track publish/cleanup, platform capability copy, and avoiding microphone ADM for screenShareAudio. The test runner required localhost socket access.

checks.name: Shared native audio-source regression test
checks.observation: PCM delivery, volume handling, stopped-source behavior, and sink removal checks passed.

checks.name: Android debug build
checks.observation: Built the Flutter APK with Java 17 and the installed Android SDK. This compiles AudioPlaybackCapture, RECORD_AUDIO permission flow, JNI bridge, and native WebRTC source; no emulator playback capture was performed.

checks.name: iOS Simulator build
checks.observation: Xcode built Runner.app and the ReplayKit Broadcast Extension, including the SwiftPM audio bridge wrappers. This is a compile check only.

checks.name: macOS debug build
checks.observation: Xcode built BOOHTACORD.app with the ScreenCaptureKit system-audio and cleanup paths. This is a compile check only.

checks.name: Dart analysis
checks.observation: No analyzer errors; 63 info-level lints remain in the existing Flutter tree. None point to files changed by this feature.

checks.name: Windows native build and playback acceptance
checks.observation: This run used a macOS host. Windows WASAPI loopback build and physical audio acceptance remain pending.

checks.name: Linux native build and playback acceptance
checks.observation: This run used a macOS host. Linux loopback requires the libpulse development package and a Linux runtime with an available monitor source.

checks.name: Android, iOS, and macOS live playback acceptance
checks.observation: No current isolated receiver session was run to prove captured samples reach another participant. App capture policies, OS permissions, and device-specific behavior remain unverified.

limitations: Android AudioPlaybackCapture can only return audio allowed by the source app and Android policy; Android 10 or newer and RECORD_AUDIO permission are required.
iOS capture requires the user to approve the ReplayKit system broadcast picker and depends on ReplayKit app-audio samples.
macOS capture requires ScreenCaptureKit audio support on macOS 13 or newer and excludes BOOHTACORD's own process audio.
A successful native build and unit tests do not prove playback audio was captured or published on physical hardware.
remaining: Run an isolated sender/receiver audio sample test on Android, iOS, and macOS; build and test Windows WASAPI on Windows; build and test Linux with libpulse; record runtime evidence for each supported target before claiming end-to-end capability.
